adjudication.rationale: The server schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` only enforces `guests` as `z.array(z.string().email())` with no dedupe/normalization/limits, while the client dialog additionally refines for uniqueness. This gap is observable in the handler too: `uniqueGuests = guests.filter(...)` does not remove duplicates within `guests`, so inputs like `["a@b.com","a@b.com"]` will pass schema and produce duplicate `createMany` entries. Additionally, blacklist checking lowercases the env list but does not lowercase incoming `guest`, so case-variant emails can bypass `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` and existing-attendee checks.
